decision_rationale: The model is described as an encoder-only Transformer, so there is no explicit generative mechanism. It is pre-trained on 36M unique ncRNA sequences and shown to generalize to unseen RNA families, which supports foundation-model-like evidence.
evidence_snippet: RiNALMo is an encoder-only Transformer; we pre-trained our RNA language model on a vast amount of ncRNA sequences; 36M unique ncRNA sequences clustered into 17M clusters; generalize well on unseen RNA families
